end.summary:
Practised estimating a large collection using a known group as a guide.
Ananya explained that an estimate is a close answer without counting each object.
They first counted three groups as 3 objects, then later counted 10, 20, 30 to estimate 30 peanuts.
Teach-back was not yet passed; 2 of 8 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group to estimate a larger collection. Ananya explained the meaning of “estimate” and recognised that spread-out bangles can still have the same count. They once counted the groups instead of the objects, but later corrected this by counting groups of 10 to estimate 30 peanuts. At home, show a small group of 5 or 10 objects and ask Ananya to use it as a guide for estimating a larger group.
